lastCompletedStory.title: Assert semver format (not literal pin) in the two real-file toolchain tests

nextStoryContext: The two real-file toolchain tests (readPinnedBunVersion()/readPinnedNodeVersion() with no injected fake path) now assert exact-semver format via toMatch(/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/) instead of the literal pinned value, so a Renovate .bun-version/.tool-versions bump no longer turns this test file red. All fake-injected tests (explicit path+reader) were left untouched and still assert exact literals ('1.3.13' x2, '22.23.1' x3). Scope is test-only, no src/ change.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Bun's own bun:test matcher API (toMatch/toBe) unchanged; no external library surface touched, pure test-assertion edit against an already-implemented internal util.
